articles.title: 'Taking in my great-grandchildren at 74 saved me'
articles.summary: A Somerset great-grandmother talks about becoming a kinship carer after her daughter died.
articles.body:
A pensioner who became a kinship carer to prevent her two great-granddaughters from going into care says she knew she had to do it despite criticism from some friends.

Valerie, 74, took responsibility for the girls when her daughter, who had been looking after them after their own parents were unable to, died suddenly.

She has been supported by Somerset Council's kinship team and said she chose to speak out during Kinship Care Week, running until Sunday, to highlight the important but often invisible role kinship carers play in our communities.

"My girls needed me. They've saved me as well as me helping them," she said.

Headlines: A royal visit and 'shin-kicking'

Banned teacher punched wall near pupils' heads

Tourism bosses say EDF 'failing' them over Pontins

Valerie said overnight she found herself not only mourning the loss of her daughter but also becoming the girls' primary carer.

Alongside supporting the children through their loss, she was faced with practical worries about finances and managing a household she had not previously been responsible for running.

Valerie admits that returning to parenting in her seventies has been a "challenge".

"I was scared because I didn't know what the future would hold," she said.

"I'm not young by any means, and I was there signing to keep the girls safe until they're 18. It's very, very scary."

She told BBC Somerset she had also lost two good friends since becoming a kinship carer.

"They said I was selfish taking them on, that I should let them be adopted to younger parents," she said.

"I can understand that for some children that might be better going to a younger family maybe.

In my case, I knew my girls extremely well. I knew my health was reasonably good. I've got a lot of energy, and I love my girls tremendously."

She said her case worker in the kinship team, Charlotte Stiles, has been "amazingly supportive".

The council supports kinship families across the county and works with carers to help children remain safely connected to their family network wherever possible.

"Charlotte is there at the end of a phone, she's come to school meetings with me, she's offered me advice, she points me in the right direction," Valerie said.

"Charlotte has made the last few years much, much easier."

Stiles said she was "blown away" by Valerie's commitment to the girls.

"I thought how incredible - she sacrificed her dream of retirement to make sure these girls have the best life they possibly could," she said.

articles.title: Jack Dorsey’s $32 million mansion renovation has been dragging on for 14 years; and his neighbors are fed up
articles.summary: Twitter co-founder Jack Dorsey has spent nearly 14 years renovating his San Francisco mansion.
articles.body: ​Twitter co-founder Jack Dorsey has spent nearly 14 years renovating his San Francisco mansion. The $32 million property in the exclusive Sea Cliff neighbourhood overlooks the Pacific Ocean and the Golden Gate Bridge. However, construction has continued since shortly after he bought the house in 2012. The project has included seismic upgrades, redesigned interiors, landscaped roofs, solar panels, pools, and extensive outdoor work, with permits filed over multiple years.​Meanwhile, construction activity has affected the surrounding neighbourhood, with residents complaining about noise, trucks, and workers occupying the streets, an SF Gate report noted. Dorsey also purchased the neighbouring property in 2018, expanding his real estate holdings to approximately 1.21 acres. Despite the scale of the investment, the renovation still frustrates neighbours along one of San Francisco's most expensive residential streets.​How Jack Dorsey's mansion renovation began​Dorsey purchased the property at 830 El Camino del Mar through a limited liability company in February 2012 for $9.99 million. Built in 1965, the modernist house has two bedrooms and two bathrooms and covers approximately 3,734 square feet on a 0.59-acre plot.​The first major redevelopment application was submitted in December 2013. Valued at $3.7 million, the proposed work included seismic strengthening, a new lower level, roof decks and a planted roof. The garage was also planned to be converted into living space.​However, the city did not issue the permit until June 2017, more than three years after the application was filed. The city later cancelled another application for a new residence and garage, while a substantial redesign submitted in February 2020 was approved in July 2022.​What the renovation includes​Architectural plans reviewed by SFGATE describe a coastal residence combining stone, glass and salvaged redwood. The design includes three planted roofs, an open central courtyard, motorised windows and skylights, and an ocean-facing balcony overlooking China Beach and the Golden Gate Bridge.​The planned amenities extend beyond the main living areas. The property includes a plunge pool, hot tub, steam room and sauna complex, along with a gym, bicycle storage, outdoor seating and a fire pit. The roofs also feature 34 solar panels.​Additional applications have covered retaining walls, driveway modifications, landscaping, fire sprinklers, batteries, an underground cistern and other infrastructure. Plumbing permits alone have continued from 2021 through 2026.​Jack Dorsey bought the neighbouring mansion​In November 2018, Dorsey purchased the neighbouring property at 840 El Camino del Mar for $21.9 million. The five-bedroom house, built in 1962, sits on about 0.62 acres and reportedly sat vacant for around 15 years before the purchase.​The combined properties cost approximately $31.9 million and cover around 1.21 acres. Although some landscaping and retaining walls cross the boundary between the two sites, the plans SFGATE reviewed do not show the houses being joined into a single structure.​Dorsey's purchases came amid a broader trend of wealthy technology executives acquiring neighbouring properties to create larger private compounds.​Why Jack Dorsey’s San Francisco neighbours are frustrated​Sea Cliff was designed as a quiet residential neighbourhood, with winding streets, greenery and views of the coastline. However, extensive construction has disrupted that atmosphere, with trucks, cement mixers, machinery and building crews frequently occupying the streets.​An SFGATE review of planning documents found that at least 24 homes along El Camino del Mar had filed building permits since the beginning of 2025. Dorsey's project is therefore part of a wider wave of renovations affecting the neighbourhood.​One neighbour expressed frustration during an SFGATE visit, saying, “This always happens.”​The work is ongoing and has turned parts of the street into a construction zone, despite the neighbourhood's well-known reputation for secluded coastal living.​Dorsey's renovation reflects the complexity of redeveloping a high-value coastal property, where structural work, landscaping and individual design changes can require separate approvals.​For residents, however, ongoing construction means noise and disruption in a neighbourhood known for its residential appeal. articles.title: New Mexico judge tosses charges against actor Timothy Busfield, citing prosecutor misconduct
articles.summary: (AP) — A New Mexico judge has dismissed an indictment against “West Wing” and “Field of Dreams” actor Timothy Busfield that accused him of criminal sexual co...
articles.body:
ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (AP) — A New Mexico judge has dismissed an indictment against "West Wing" and "Field of Dreams" actor Timothy Busfield that accused him of criminal sexual contact with a child, citing prosecutorial misconduct and errors that undermined the grand jury process.

State District Judge Joseph Montano granted a defense motion to toss the charges in a decision released Friday.

Busfield has repeatedly denied the allegations, describing them as lies motivated by revenge. In an email Friday, Busfield's attorney Amber Fayerberg said he was "relieved and grateful" after reading the judge's decision.

Prosecutors said Friday they had not yet decided whether to pursue another indictment.

The case stems from when Busfield was directing the TV series "The Cleaning Lady" from 2022 to 2024. The parents of two twin boys who were let go from the show claimed that Busfield inappropriately touched the children on the set in Albuquerque.

According to a criminal complaint filed in January, an investigator with the Albuquerque Police Department said a boy reported that Busfield touched him on his private areas over his clothing on one occasion when he was 7 years old and another time when he was 8. The boy's twin brother told authorities he was also touched by Busfield, but he did not specify where and didn't say anything because he didn't want to get in trouble, the complaint said.

Busfield turned himself in and was released from jail pending trial by a judge who found no pattern of criminal conduct or similar allegations involving children in Busfield's past.

The grand jury indictment followed just weeks later, reiterating allegations that Busfield "touched or applied force to the intimate parts" of one of the boys on several occasions. The indictment allowed the case to proceed without a preliminary hearing on evidence.

Busfield's attorneys noted that the children told police during initial interviews that Busfield didn't touch them inappropriately and accused the boys' parents of coaching their children to give incriminating statements after the boys lost lucrative roles on the show.

In June, Busfield's attorneys officially asked the court to throw out the indictment, alleging in a motion that prosecutors were "willfully blind to the lack of evidence" and "invented procedural hurdles" to keep grand jurors from hearing witness testimony.

During a September hearing, Fayerberg played audio recordings of grand jurors asking to hear from additional witnesses. She said prosecutors wrongly informed jurors that subpoenas would be needed, even though those witnesses were "present, available and willing to testify."

"The state engaged in egregious prosecutorial misconduct," Fayerberg said.

Bernalillo County District Attorney Greer Staley countered that the defense hadn't followed the correct process for submitting evidence to a grand jury and that Busfield himself improperly and "excessively" tried to steer grand jurors toward favorable witnesses and exhibits during his three-hour testimony.

According to the transcripts of the proceedings submitted by Busfield's attorneys, the actor also known for appearances in "Thirtysomething" told jurors that the case had turned his life upside down and affected his entire family. He testified that he had been "canceled," meaning he lost work and was fired by his agency.

Busfield also testified that he had nothing to hide and when asked about the allegations that he had caressed the children, he answered: "I'm saying that is absolutely one gazillion percent untrue. Never ever."

Prosecutors had said each count in the indictment carried a possible penalty of six years in prison that could be enhanced.

"We know this may not be the end," Fayerberg said. "If the State chooses to try again, Tim is ready, and so are those witnesses."

This story was first published on Oct. 16, 2026. It was updated on Oct. 17, 2026 to correct the name of Busfield's attorney. Her name is Amber Fayerberg, not Amanda Fayerberg.

articles.title: IFPA Santarém abre 400 vagas em cursos técnicos e superiores | G1
articles.standfirst: Oportunidades são para cursos técnicos integrados, subsequentes e de graduação. Prazo de inscrição vai até 16 de novembro.
articles.summary: O IFPA Santarém recebe inscrições para 400 vagas em cursos técnicos e superiores gratuitos com prazo de candidatura aberto até o dia 16 de novembro.
articles.body:
Instituto Federal do Pará (IFPA) Campus Santarém — Foto: Arquivo G1

O Instituto Federal do Pará (IFPA), Campus Santarém , abriu as inscrições para o Processo Seletivo Unificado (PSU) 2027. Ao todo, são ofertadas 400 vagas gratuitas em cursos técnicos e de nível superior. Os interessados podem se candidatar exclusivamente pela internet até o dia 16 de novembro de 2026.

As vagas estão divididas entre três modalidades de ensino. Veja a distribuição:

Destinados a estudantes que vão cursar o ensino médio junto com o técnico.

Áreas: Agropecuária, Aquicultura, Edificações, Informática e Saneamento.

Para quem já concluiu o ensino médio e busca apenas a formação técnica.

Cursos Superiores / Graduação (120 vagas)

Áreas: Agronomia, Engenharia Civil e Matemática.

As inscrições devem ser feitas pelo portal oficial de processos seletivos do IFPA. O valor da taxa de inscrição varia conforme o nível do curso:

Isenção da taxa: Candidatos que atendem aos critérios de baixa renda estabelecidos no edital podem solicitar a isenção do pagamento até o dia 30 de outubro de 2026.

O pagamento da taxa deve ser feito por meio da Guia de Recolhimento da União (GRU). O IFPA orienta que o candidato aguarde duas horas após a emissão do boleto para efetuar o pagamento.

No momento da inscrição, o candidato deve preencher o formulário eletrônico e anexar os seguintes documentos digitalizados:

Documento oficial de identificação com foto;

Histórico escolar, boletim ou declaração de escolaridade com as notas (conforme a modalidade escolhida).

Além das vagas para Santarém, o processo seletivo do IFPA também oferta vagas para os campi de Alenquer, Itaituba e Óbidos, cujos requisitos específicos devem ser consultados nos editais de cada município.

articles.title: Avião com 4 pessoas faz pouso de emergência em rio no interior do Acre | G1
articles.standfirst: Emergência ocorreu próximo à Aldeia Nova Moema, em Santa Rosa do Purus. Um dos ocupantes relatou que a aeronave planou por cerca de 4 minutos com vazamento de óleo até pousar.
articles.summary: Emergência ocorreu próximo à Aldeia Nova Moema, em Santa Rosa do Purus. Um dos ocupantes relatou que a aeronave planou por cerca de 4 minutos com vazamento de óleo até pousar.
articles.body:
Testemunhas filmaram avião afundando no rio após o pouso forçado, todos os 4 ocupantes sobreviveram — Foto: Reprodução

Um avião precisou fazer um pouso de emergência em um rio na manhã deste sábado (17), próximo à Aldeia Nova Moema, em Santa Rosa do Purus , no interior do Acre. Conforme um passageiro, quatro pessoas estavam na aeronave e sobreviveram.

O apresentador Marcos Bergson, que estava no voo, informou à Rede Amazônica que o avião teve vazamento de óleo e uma pane no motor, e planou por cerca de quatro minutos até encontrar o rio para o pouso forçado. Ainda segundo ele, o piloto teve fraturas nas costelas e deslocou um ombro.

"Estávamos retornando para Manoel Urbano , 15 minutos após a decolagem, o motor começou a apresentar falha. Não dava tempo de voltar e tivemos que pousar no rio", informou.

O voo tinha como destino Manoel Urbano, onde os passageiros seguiriam viagem de carro com destino à capital.

articles.title: Falta de água em Petrolina: moradores relatam 5 dias sem serviço | G1
articles.standfirst: Parada programada deveria ter sido concluída na quinta-feira (15), mas problema técnico estendeu o desabastecimento. Moradores de diversos bairros relatam torneiras secas.
articles.summary: A falta de água em Petrolina afeta mais de 60 bairros após atraso em manutenção da Compesa, que agora trabalha para restabelecer o serviço gradualmente.
articles.body:
Moradores de pelo menos dez bairros de Petrolina, no Sertão de Pernambuco, enfrentam problemas com o desabastecimento de água. Segundo relatos enviados ao g1, em comunidades como Vila Eulália, João de Deus e Ipsep I, as torneiras estão secas há mais de cinco dias.

A dona de casa Thais Gomes mora com os filhos no bairro Vila Eulália e relata a dificuldade de passar quase uma semana sem o serviço em meio às altas temperaturas da região.

"Eu não sei mais o que fazer. As crianças, com calor, não podem tomar banho, não tem água para beber. Eu não sei o que fazer", lamenta.

No bairro João de Deus, a situação é semelhante. A moradora Jéssica Silva conta que a rotina foi afetada pela seca nas torneiras. "Desde terça-feira que está sem água", destaca.

Problemas com o cronograma e falta de pressão

A jornalista Roseane Albuquerque mora no bairro Ipsep I, em uma rua próxima a uma caixa d’água da Companhia Pernambucana de Saneamento (Compesa), localizada na Avenida Nordeste, no bairro José e Maria. A proximidade com o reservatório, no entanto, não tem garantido o abastecimento.

“A gente está aqui em um suplício porque [a água] faltou antes do horário que estava marcado na terça-feira, e não retornou no prazo. Eu lembro que, à 1h ou 2h da manhã, eu ainda estava verificando se estava chegando, e nada. Ouvi algumas pessoas aqui nas imediações dizendo que estava chegando água, só que as minhas torneiras são altas. Então, até ter a pressão para subir e a água descer, é mais complicado. Fui ver um pouquinho de água hoje, por volta das 8h da manhã, mas era apenas um fiapo”, relata Roseane.

A Compesa realizou, na quarta (14) e quinta-feira (15), uma parada programada no Sistema de Abastecimento de Petrolina. Segundo a companhia, a suspensão temporária foi necessária para a execução de serviços de manutenção corretiva e melhorias nas Estações de Tratamento de Água (ETAs) do município. Mais de 60 bairros foram afetados.

A Compesa afirmou que o trabalho seria dividido em duas etapas para reduzir os impactos na cidade. O fornecimento de água deveria voltar de forma gradativa na quinta-feira, após o fim do serviço.

No entanto, na sexta-feira (16), a companhia informou que precisou realizar um trabalho emergencial para restabelecer o abastecimento . A parada programada, que deveria ter sido concluída na quinta, precisou ser estendida após um problema técnico na retomada do sistema.

Segundo a Compesa, ao iniciar a retomada da distribuição a partir da ETA Centro, na noite de quinta-feira, houve uma "ocorrência técnica", mas a empresa não detalhou a gravidade do problema.

Procurada pelo g1 neste sábado (17) para responder sobre as reclamações dos moradores, a Compesa informou que o serviço está sendo retomado gradativamente na cidade. De acordo com a companhia, a normalização completa pode demorar um pouco mais em algumas áreas devido à grande quantidade de bairros afetados pelo desligamento do sistema.

articles.title: Polícia usa gás lacrimogêneo e entra em confronto com manifestantes em protestos contra o custo de vida na França | G1
articles.standfirst: Protestos começaram com estudantes e se espalharam pelo país, em meio à insatisfação com o custo de vida e os serviços públicos.
articles.summary: Protestos começaram com estudantes e se espalharam pelo país, em meio à insatisfação com o custo de vida e os serviços públicos.
articles.body:
A polícia francesa usou gás lacrimogêneo e entrou em confronto com manifestantes em várias cidades da França neste sábado (17), durante uma onda de protestos contra o alto custo de vida e as condições dos serviços públicos. Os atos, que levaram milhares de pessoas às ruas, estão entre os mais violentos registrados no país nos últimos anos.

Segundo as autoridades francesas, até o meio-dia foram contabilizadas 140 manifestações, com a participação de 32,8 mil pessoas, fora de Paris. O governo atribuiu os episódios de violência a grupos classificados como de "ultraesquerda".

Os protestos começaram no mês passado em escolas de ensino médio de bairros pobres da periferia norte de Paris. Inicialmente, os estudantes reivindicavam mais professores e melhorias na infraestrutura das escolas. Com o passar das semanas, a mobilização ganhou força e passou a incorporar críticas à desigualdade social, aos gastos públicos e à queda do poder de compra da população.

O Ministério do Interior informou que episódios de violência foram registrados em diversas cidades, incluindo atos de vandalismo em Marselha e ataques contra policiais, profissionais da imprensa e prédios públicos.

Em Paris, um forte esquema de segurança foi montado na região central, especialmente nas proximidades de pontos turísticos como a Avenida Champs-Élysées e o Arco do Triunfo. Os dois locais ficaram fora dos trajetos autorizados para as manifestações.

Manifestantes vestidos com coletes de alta visibilidade bloquearam ruas, em cenas que remetem ao movimento dos "coletes amarelos", que marcou o mandato anterior do presidente Emmanuel Macron.

Policiais passam por objetos em chamas durante protesto contra o alto custo de vida em Paris. — Foto: Reuters

Em Marselha, o prefeito afirmou que a sede da prefeitura foi vandalizada. Após conversas com o primeiro-ministro e o ministro do Interior, o governo decidiu enviar reforços policiais à cidade.

"Estamos lutando porque o custo de vida está insuportável, porque o preço dos combustíveis está muito alto, porque estudantes do ensino médio estão sendo violentamente atacados e feridos em todo o país simplesmente por tentarem protestar e pedir mais professores e condições dignas de ensino", afirmou Lola, uma manifestante de 19 anos, em Paris.

Segundo uma testemunha da Reuters, cerca de 100 pessoas caminharam em direção ao ponto de concentração dos protestos gritando palavras de ordem contra a polícia, incluindo "Todos os policiais são bastardos".

Macron, que pediu calma na sexta-feira (16), entra na reta final de seu mandato em meio a um cenário político fragmentado e à crescente pressão sobre a economia francesa.

Protestos contra o alto custo de vida se espalham pela França. — Foto: REUTERS/Jack Taylor

As tentativas do governo de reduzir a dívida pública não conseguiram tranquilizar os investidores. Como consequência, os custos de financiamento do governo francês atingiram os níveis mais altos em mais de duas décadas.

A atuação das forças de segurança tem sido questionada após uma série de manifestantes ficarem feridos durante os protestos. Entre os casos está o de um adolescente que perdeu uma das mãos depois de pegar uma granada de efeito moral.

O primeiro-ministro francês, Sébastien Lecornu, afirmou que mais de 900 policiais também ficaram feridos durante os confrontos.

O órgão responsável por fiscalizar a atuação policial investiga pelo menos 24 denúncias de violência cometida por agentes de segurança.

A França chegou a suspender o uso de granadas de efeito moral durante as manifestações estudantis. No entanto, o ministro do Interior, Laurent Nuñez, afirmou que os equipamentos poderiam voltar a ser utilizados neste sábado.

Convocações feitas pelas redes sociais para que participantes de movimentos de protesto anteriores se juntassem às manifestações parecem ter ampliado a mobilização, aumentando a possibilidade de atos ainda maiores.

O movimento dos "coletes amarelos" surgiu em 2018, inicialmente em oposição ao aumento dos impostos sobre o diesel. Posteriormente, transformou-se em uma onda de protestos contra o alto custo de vida e a desigualdade social.

A mobilização perdeu força depois que Macron anunciou bilhões de euros em cortes de impostos.

Yannick Maillou, professor de La Crèche, no oeste da França, que participou do movimento dos coletes amarelos, afirmou que vários pontos de concentração foram organizados na região para os protestos deste sábado. Segundo ele, sindicatos também incentivaram a participação da população.

articles.title: Dia do Comerciário em Petrolina: veja o que abre e fecha | G1
articles.standfirst: Nesta segunda-feira (19) supermercados, estabelecimentos da cidade terão seu funcionamento alterado devido ao feriado.
articles.summary: O Dia do Comerciário em Petrolina altera o funcionamento de lojas e supermercados nesta segunda-feira (19); confira os horários do shopping e serviços.
articles.body:
Comércio Petrolina — Foto: Emerson Rocha / g1 Petrolina

Nesta segunda-feira (19), é celebrado o Dia do Comerciário. Devido ao feriado municipal, o horário de funcionamento de supermercados, estabelecimentos da cidade será alterado em Petrolina , no Sertão de Pernambuco. Saiba o que abre e fecha na cidade.

O comércio de Petrolina deve permanecer fechado durante o feriado, mas a abertura é facultativa. O comerciante que deseja abrir seu negócio na segunda, deve seguir as regras estabelecidas nas cláusulas 48 e 49 da Convenção Coletiva de Trabalho vigente .

Na segunda, as lojas do shopping estarão fechadas. O Carrefour funcionará das 8h às 21h, enquanto a Praça de Alimentação estará aberta das 12h às 22h.

articles.title: Itapetininga registra aumento de quase 30% nas medidas protetivas | G1
articles.standfirst: Levantamento divulgado pela SSP aponta que houve um aumento de 26,7% entre janeiro e agosto deste ano, em comparação ao mesmo período do ano anterior.
articles.summary: Levantamento divulgado pela SSP aponta que houve um aumento de 26,7% entre janeiro e agosto deste ano, em comparação ao mesmo período do ano anterior.
articles.body:
Itapetininga (SP) registrou um aumento de 26,7% no número de medidas protetivas solicitadas e concedidas a mulheres vítimas de violência doméstica, segundo dados da Secretaria de Segurança Pública de São Paulo (SSP-SP).

O levantamento considera o período de janeiro a agosto deste ano, em comparação com os mesmos meses de 2025.

Em entrevista à TV TEM , a advogada criminalista Eliane Caixeiro explica que diferentes fatores podem ter contribuído para o aumento. Entre eles, estão o maior acesso das mulheres aos mecanismos de denúncia e proteção e a possibilidade de um crescimento nos casos de violência.

"Não podemos negar que vivemos em uma sociedade patriarcal, então, precisamos combatê-la. Mas, também há a facilidade. A mulher, hoje em dia, pode requerer a medida protetiva com a Delegacia de Defesa da Mulher (DDM) de forma online, pelo aplicativo SP Mulher Segura", diz.

Delegacia de Defesa da Mulher (DDM) de Itapetininga (SP) — Foto: Reprodução/Google Street View

A profissional reforça que, desde 2023, as mulheres vítimas de violência doméstica não precisam fazer um boletim de ocorrência para que a medida protetiva seja solicitada . No entanto, o registro do documento é essencial.

"Essa facilidade fez com que a burocratização parasse e surgisse uma facilidade a mais. Não há mais a necessidade do boletim, mas sempre instruo para que ele seja sim feito, pois, assim, o crime será investigado. As mulheres podem fazer isso por meio do telefone 180 ou pela DDM on-line, onde ela pode anexar todos os tipos de prova e fazer o pedido da medida protetiva", finaliza.

Eliane orienta mulheres a registrarem o boletim de ocorrência — Foto: Reprodução/TV TEM

articles.title: Policiais de cadeia onde Milton Leite está são ouvidos sobre regalias | G1
articles.standfirst: Órgão apura suspeita de tratamento diferenciado ao ex-presidente da Câmara de São Paulo em Mogi das Cruzes. MP também investiga suposta ligação de Milton Leite com membros do PCC.
articles.summary: Órgão apura suspeita de tratamento diferenciado ao ex-presidente da Câmara de São Paulo em Mogi das Cruzes. MP também investiga suposta ligação de Milton Leite com PCC.
articles.body:
A Corregedoria da Polícia Civil de São Paulo começou a ouvir neste sábado (17), na capital paulista, a delegada seccional de Mogi das Cruzes, o delegado titular do 1º Distrito Policial da cidade e um dos carcereiros da cadeia pública onde está preso o ex-presidente da Câmara Municipal de São Paulo, Milton Leite .

Os três foram intimados a prestar esclarecimentos em um desdobramento da operação do Ministério Público (MP) realizada na quinta-feira (16), que apura suspeitas de irregularidades e favorecimentos dentro da unidade prisional . A defesa de Milton negou que seu cliente tenha recebido quaisquer regalias (leia nota abaixo) .

Entre os policiais que serão ouvidos está Margarette Barreto, delegada seccional de Mogi das Cruzes. A equipe de reportagem não conseguiu localizar ela e os demais citados para comentar o assunto.

Milton Leite está preso temporariamente por decisão da Justiça sob suspeita de integrar uma organização criminosa e de manter relações com integrantes do Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC), segundo investigação do MP. O ex-presidente da Câmara também nega essas acusações.

Milton Leite está preso na cadeia do 1º DP de Mogi das Cruzes. — Foto: Reprodução

O objetivo da Corregedoria é entender em detalhes o funcionamento da cadeia e verificar a regularidade da atuação dos agentes responsáveis pela custódia dos presos. A correição extraordinária foi instaurada por determinação do corregedor João Beolchi e já identificou falhas preliminares em procedimentos internos.

A análise completa dependerá dos documentos apreendidos pela Promotoria durante a operação, que devem ser compartilhados com a Corregedoria nos próximos dias. As oitivas deste sábado têm previsão de durar entre três e quatro horas.

Na quinta-feira, promotores e policiais cumpriram mandados de busca na cadeia pública de Mogi das Cruzes para apurar denúncias de que presos recebiam benefícios irregulares. Um carcereiro passou a ser investigado por suspeita de facilitar essas vantagens. Durante a operação, investigadores apreenderam R$ 155 mil e US$ 10 mil (cerca de R$ 55 mil) com o servidor .

Em nota, a defesa de Milton Leite negou qualquer irregularidade. Segundo os advogados Aloísio Medeiros e Rodrigo Araújo, o ex-presidente da Câmara "não recebe e nunca recebeu qualquer tipo de regalia ou tratamento diferenciado na unidade em que está custodiado".

A defesa também afirmou que não teve acesso à investigação conduzida pelo Ministério Público e declarou que o político e seus representantes estão à disposição para colaborar com as apurações.

Dinheiro foi encontrado na casa do carcereiro durante uma busca realizada na cadeia onde Leite está preso — Foto: Dilvulgação

articles.title: Chuva no Vale do Paraíba e Litoral Norte provoca quedas e estragos | G1
articles.standfirst: Ocorrências foram registradas neste sábado (17), após chuva e rajadas de vento no Vale do Paraíba e Litoral Norte; em São Luiz do Paraitinga, temporal matou oito bovinos e provocou deslizamento em rodovia.
articles.summary: Chuva no Vale do Paraíba e Litoral Norte causou queda de árvores, morte de animais e interdição na Rodovia Oswaldo Cruz neste sábado (17).
articles.body:
Chuva e ventos fortes provocam desabamento de telhado, queda de árvore e outros estragos no Vale — Foto: Foto 1: Hamilton Silva/Vanguarda Repórter | Foto 2: Defesa Civil de SP

A chuva forte e as rajadas de vento provocaram estragos em cidades do Vale do Paraíba e do Litoral Norte entre a noite de sexta-feira (16) e a manhã deste sábado (17).

Em São José dos Campos , uma árvore caiu sobre cabos de energia; em São Sebastião, a cobertura de uma garagem de ônibus desabou; e, em São Luiz do Paraitinga , oito bovinos morreram após uma descarga elétrica, uma casa ficou alagada e houve deslizamento de terra na Rodovia Oswaldo Cruz (SP-125).

A árvore caiu na Rua Geraldo Ribeiro da Costa, no bairro Vila São Geraldo, na Zona Norte de São José dos Campos. Segundo o morador Hamilton Silva, que enviou uma imagem pelo aplicativo Vanguarda Repórter, a árvore está tensionando os cabos de energia.

A Prefeitura e a concessionária EDP foram acionadas sobre a ocorrência. O g1 aguarda retorno.

Queda de árvore em São José dos Campos — Foto: Hamilton Silva/Vanguarda Repórter

Cobertura de garagem desaba em São Sebastião

Em São Sebastião, as fortes chuvas acompanhadas de rajadas de vento provocaram a queda da estrutura de cobertura da garagem da empresa de transporte público SOU São Sebastião.

Segundo a Defesa Civil estadual, o incidente aconteceu na Rua do Outeiro, na Vila Industrial. Não houve vítimas.

A Defesa Civil informou que equipes seguem em campo, monitorando a região e prestando apoio aos moradores afetados.

Cobertura de garagem desaba em São Sebastião — Foto: Divulgação/Defesa Civil de SP

Chuva provoca estragos em São Luiz do Paraitinga

Em São Luiz do Paraitinga, uma forte chuva provocou ocorrências em diferentes pontos da cidade. No bairro dos Medeiros, uma descarga elétrica matou oito bovinos. No Alto do Cruzeiro, uma árvore caiu, e uma residência ficou alagada no bairro São Benedito.

Na Rodovia Oswaldo Cruz (SP-125), na altura do km 42, um deslizamento de terra provocou a interdição parcial da pista. Segundo a Defesa Civil, a concessionária aguardava a chegada de maquinário para remover o material.

O tráfego seguia fluindo, com veículos no sentido sul passando pelo acostamento. Até a última atualização da Defesa Civil, não havia registro de vítimas, desabrigados ou desalojados no município.

Chuva forte mata oito bovinos e provoca alagamento e deslizamento em São Luiz do Paraitinga, SP — Foto: Divulgação/Defesa Civil de SP

articles.title: Três Rios registra 21 ocorrências após 85 mm de chuva em 24 horas | G1
articles.standfirst: Balanço preliminar da Defesa Civil contabiliza 21 chamados, incluindo 12 deslizamentos de terra e quedas de muros; vias foram afetadas.
articles.summary: Balanço preliminar da Defesa Civil contabiliza 21 chamados, incluindo 12 deslizamentos de terra e quedas de muros; vias foram afetadas.
articles.body:
O temporal que atingiu Três Rios (RJ) na sexta-feira (16) provocou pelo menos 21 ocorrências e deixou 11 pessoas desalojadas na manhã deste sábado (17). O município acumulou cerca de 85 milímetros de precipitação em um período de 24 horas.

Segundo a Defesa Civil, entre as ocorrências registradas até o momento estão nove deslizamentos de talude, três deslizamentos de terra que causaram interdições em vias públicas, três quedas de muro, dois pontos com risco iminente de desmoronamento, dois alagamentos e a interdição de dois imóveis. Também houve registro de interdição parcial de trecho no bairro Triângulo.

No bairro Jardim Glória, duas residências precisaram ser totalmente interditadas por questão de segurança estrutural. Ao todo, 11 moradores, quatro adultos e sete crianças, ficaram desalojados e foram acolhidos pela Secretaria Municipal de Assistência Social, que realiza o acompanhamento das famílias.

Três Rios registra 21 ocorrências após 85 mm de chuva em 24 horas — Foto: Divulgação/Defesa Civil

Ainda de acordo com a Defesa Civil, equipes permanecem nas ruas vistoriando áreas de encosta, desobstruindo acessos e monitorando os pontos de maior vulnerabilidade. Por se tratar de um levantamento preliminar, os números ainda podem passar por atualizações ao longo do dia.

A orientação é de que moradores de áreas com histórico de deslizamento ou alagamento a manterem atenção redobrada. Caso sejam identificadas rachaduras em paredes ou no solo, inclinação de postes e árvores, ou movimentações de terra, a recomendação é sair do imóvel imediatamente e acionar os números de emergência da Defesa Civil (199) ou do Corpo de Bombeiros (193).

articles.title: Sucuri entra em barco com turistas no Pantanal e surpreende fotógrafo | G1
articles.standfirst: Fotógrafo registrava imagens entre Porto Esperança e a Serra do Amolar, quando o animal se aproximou das embarcações e entrou em uma delas.
articles.summary: Fotógrafo registrava imagens entre Porto Esperança e a Serra do Amolar, quando o animal se aproximou das embarcações e entrou em uma delas.
articles.body:
O fotógrafo Vinicius Eduardo registrou um momento inusitado durante um passeio pelo rio Paraguai Mirim, no Pantanal de Mato Grosso do Sul: uma sucuri entrou em um dos barcos usados por turistas. O animal se aproximou das embarcações e entrou em uma delas. Depois, foi retirado para que o passeio pudesse continuar. Veja o vídeo acima.

Nas imagens, a sucuri aparece dentro do barco, enquanto os turistas acompanham a cena de perto.

Ao g1 , o fotógrafo contou que estava com um piloteiro em uma das embarcações para fazer fotos e vídeos do trecho entre Porto Esperança, em Corumbá, e a Serra do Amolar. Ao chegar a determinado ponto do rio, o piloteiro percebeu a aproximação do animal.

"Ela veio até perto do barco por baixo, levantou a cabeça, olhava por tudo. É algo normal ali, porque ela tá no habitat dela", contou.

Segundo Vinicius, a sucuri passou por baixo das embarcações e também pelo meio das pessoas. Ele descreveu o comportamento do animal como manso, mas alertou que é preciso ter cuidado. "Dificilmente ela vai atacar alguém na água limpa, mas não pode confiar muito."

Sucuri tentou entrar no barco duas vezes

O fotógrafo relatou que a sucuri tentou entrar no barco duas vezes. Na primeira, foi impedida. Na segunda, os ocupantes permitiram a entrada do animal, que entrou sozinho na embarcação. Os turistas acompanharam a cena.

"Se você não ficar marcando ali ela entra dentro do barco e você nem vê, e vai embora com ela ali dentro. É perigoso, tem que tomar cuidado, mas é uma coisa que já é normal da região", contou.

Vinicius disse ainda que aquela não foi a única sucuri avistada durante o passeio. Segundo ele, o grupo viu cerca de dois ou três animais na mesma região.

"É bem legal, bem incrível, nossa, sem palavras. A experiência é única. Dá um pouco de medo, mas consegui registrar aquele momento ali", finaliza.

Sucuri entrou no barco e surpreendeu turistas no Pantanal — Foto: Vinicius Eduardo

articles.title: Justiça proíbe mãe de se aproximar da filha de 12 anos no RN | G1
articles.standfirst: Medida protetiva foi concedida após relatos de ameaças, ofensas e agressão física; decisão também restringe visitas e determina acompanhamento psicossocial.
articles.summary: Justiça em Caicó proibiu uma mãe de se aproximar da filha de 12 anos após relatos de ameaças e agressão. Medida prevê distância mínima de 200 metros.
articles.body:
A Justiça do Rio Grande do Norte concedeu medidas protetivas de urgência em favor de uma adolescente de 12 anos após relatos de ameaças, ofensas e agressão física atribuídas à mãe biológica.

A decisão da 1ª Vara da Comarca de Caicó proíbe a mulher de se aproximar da filha e da responsável de fato pela menina a menos de 200 metros, além de impedir qualquer tipo de contato presencial ou virtual.

Segundo os autos do processo, o episódio ocorreu em 10 de junho de 2026. Na ocasião, a mãe biológica teria entrado sem autorização na residência da responsável pela adolescente e exigido levá-la. Ainda conforme o relato apresentado à Justiça, a mulher teria feito ameaças, proferido ofensas e puxado os cabelos da menina.

Ao analisar o caso, o juiz Eduardo André Dantas Silva considerou que os elementos apresentados indicavam a necessidade de proteger a integridade física e psicológica da adolescente. A decisão teve como fundamento a Lei nº 14.344/2022, conhecida como Lei Henry Borel, que prevê mecanismos de prevenção e enfrentamento à violência doméstica e familiar contra crianças e adolescentes.

Além de proibir a aproximação e o contato, a Justiça restringiu as visitas presenciais até nova decisão judicial. Também determinou que a adolescente e seu núcleo familiar afetivo sejam incluídos nos serviços de assistência social e saúde por meio do Programa de Atendimento Especializado a Famílias e Indivíduos (PAEFI), vinculado ao Centro de Referência Especializado de Assistência Social (CREAS).

O descumprimento das medidas pode configurar crime, com pena prevista de detenção de três meses a dois anos, além da possibilidade de prisão preventiva, conforme as circunstâncias do caso.

As medidas permanecerão em vigor enquanto persistir a situação de risco e poderão ser reavaliadas pela Justiça.

articles.body: TIRUPATI: After Punganur, violent clashes erupted between the TDP and the YSRCP at multiple places across Kadapa district on the second day of the nominations filing phase on Saturday.At former chief minister YS Jagan Mohan Reddy’s home constituency Pulivendula, Police had to open six rounds of fire in the air when the YSRCP activists tried to storm into the nominations filing centre in large numbers on Saturday.Trouble reportedly broke out when the police personnel on ground asked the YSRCP nominees and their supporters to wait for a few minutes to be allowed into the nominations centre as the TDP nominees and their supporters were already inside.However, when the YSRCP nominees and their supporters tried to storm into the nominations centre following a heated altercation with the police, the situation escalated and the on-ground cops opened six rounds of fire in the air besides resorting to lathicharge to contain the situation.Meanwhile, clashes between the YSRCP and the TDP were also reported at several nomination centres at Kadapa, Mydukur and Rayachoti as well.The TDP and the YSRCP cadres were involved in fierce stone pelting acts at Kagithalapenta nomination centre and at Gandhi Nagar as well. articles.title: Why Trump's plan to unleash 'Mother Of All Bombs' may fall flat in Iran
articles.summary: The 'Mother of All Bombs' has the name, the weight and the explosive punch. What it may not have is the right tool for the job the US wants it to do.
articles.body: The 'Mother of All Bombs' has the name, the weight and the explosive punch. What it may not have is the right tool for the job the US wants it to do.Reports of possible US discussions about deploying the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast (MOAB) against Iran have put the giant conventional bomb back in focus. Weighing just under 10,000 kg, it made its combat debut in April 2017 against an Islamic State tunnel complex in Afghanistan, producing the kind of images that cemented its fearsome reputation.But Iran's most important nuclear and military facilities are not sitting ducks in the open. Many are buried beneath mountains or shielded by reinforced concrete. And the MOAB, despite its enormous explosive power, is an air-burst weapon, not a specialised bunker-buster.In other words, a spectacular explosion does not necessarily mean a successful strike. Against Iran's deeply buried infrastructure, the bomb's biggest strength could also prove to be its biggest limitation.A big blast, not a bunker-busterThe central problem is the MOAB's design. Unlike penetrator bombs, which burrow through soil, concrete and rock before detonating, the MOAB is an air-burst weapon that explodes above the surface, spreading a powerful overpressure wave across a wide area.This makes it effective against personnel and structures in the open, lightly protected infrastructure, cave entrances and exposed military positions. But much of its energy dissipates horizontally rather than downward. While surface structures can be flattened, heavily fortified underground complexes are far more likely to survive.Iran's most important assets are not housed in vulnerable surface buildings. Many are concealed beneath mountains and protected by reinforced concrete, meaning the MOAB's explosive power may not translate into the ability to destroy the targets that matter most.An MOAB strike by US may fail to achieve total annihilation or destruction of a target for several key structural, technical, and operational reasons such as inability to penetrate especially in the mountainous terrain with heavy doors which may absorb the blast effect and since the bomb’s lethal over pressure radius could be localised.Iran's underground defenceIran's nuclear programme illustrates the challenge. Since the early 2000s, Iranian planners have anticipated that key facilities could be targeted by American or Israeli air strikes. As a result, they have placed considerable emphasis on underground construction and hardening.The enrichment facilities at Natanz include underground sections reportedly protected by thick layers of concrete and located roughly 40 to 50 metres below the surface.Satellite imagery and open-source analysis have also pointed to extensive tunnelling in mountains near the site. Analysts estimate that some sections could lie even deeper beneath the rock. Such depths pose a challenge even for specialised bunker-busting weapons.A weapon designed to create a blast wave above the surface would have little prospect of destroying these facilities, since mountain rock absorbs and disperses shockwaves.Iran's wider military doctrine reinforces this strategy. Over the past two decades, Tehran has publicised underground missile depots, tunnel networks, protected command centres, drone facilities and hardened storage sites.This tunnelling is a direct response to the conventional air superiority of the United States and Israel. By dispersing vital assets beneath mountains and across multiple locations, Iran has sought to blunt precision-strike campaigns. The assumption is that even an adversary that controls the skies would find it extremely difficult to destroy every critical underground installation.The MOAB does not change that equation because it was never designed to defeat deeply buried infrastructure on a large scale. North Korea, too, has tunnelled beneath mountains to protect key military infrastructure.Mountains further complicate the task. While blast waves travel freely across open terrain, natural barriers can absorb, redirect and diffuse the energy of an explosion. Even a weapon with the MOAB's explosive power would face limitations against installations hidden inside or behind mountain formations.Aircraft carrying MOAB faces its own risksOperational factors also count against the bomb. Unlike many precision-guided munitions that can be carried by fighter aircraft or stealth bombers, the MOAB must be dropped from a specially modified MC-130 transport aircraft.Transport aircraft are far less survivable in contested airspace than stealth bombers. Before a MOAB could be used against a strategic target in Iran, American forces would probably have to suppress large parts of Iran's air defence network and establish air superiority. That would be a major campaign in itself.Securing the airspace would take time. Once that was achieved, planners would have a wider range of strike options and would likely favour weapons better suited to hardened underground targets.Why GBU-57 is better suitedThe GBU-57 Massive Ordnance Penetrator offers a clear contrast to the MOAB. It was developed to attack deeply buried facilities that conventional bombs cannot reliably destroy.Where the MOAB relies on blast, the GBU-57 has a hardened casing designed to penetrate layers of rock and reinforced concrete before exploding. American B-2 bombers used it against Iranian nuclear sites in June 2025.Planning discussions about hardened underground sites have centred on penetrator weapons rather than large air-blast munitions. The reasoning follows a basic military principle: the target dictates the weapon.Against caves, trenches and exposed positions, the MOAB may be effective. Against deeply buried nuclear facilities protected by mountains, penetrator weapons are far more relevant.Psychological impact could outweigh military gainsThe MOAB's reputation may be disproportionate to its practical military utility. The weapon is designed not only to destroy certain targets but also to intimidate.Images of an enormous explosion can carry strategic messaging value, as they did after its use in April 2017. This can be particularly important when policymakers seek to demonstrate resolve or deterrence. A MOAB strike could therefore generate significant psychological and propaganda effects, dominating media coverage.But strategic success depends not on headlines but on outcomes.If Iran's critical facilities survived an attack involving one of America's most powerful conventional weapons, the Iranian regime could present it as a propaganda victory. Surviving such a strike could allow Tehran to portray its investments in underground defences as vindicated.Rather than demonstrating overwhelming American power, an unsuccessful strike against hardened facilities could reinforce perceptions of Iranian resilience.Escalation is another concern. Any operation against Iran would take place amid maritime trade routes, energy infrastructure, proxy networks and missile forces.If a MOAB strike failed to destroy its intended target, the United States could still face serious retaliation from Iran and its partners. Military planners generally look for a clear relationship between operational risks and potential gains. A highly visible weapon that raises tensions while inflicting limited damage on the facilities that matter most would be difficult to justify.A mismatch between weapon and targetThe MOAB's limitations against Iran come down to a mismatch between the weapon and its intended targets. It was built to produce devastating blast effects over exposed areas, destroy cave complexes and shock an opponent.Iran's strategic infrastructure has been adapted to withstand precisely these kinds of conventional threats through deep underground construction, mountainous geography, hardened facilities, dispersed networks and extensive tunnelling.The MOAB could inflict significant damage on selected surface targets, but it would probably struggle to neutralise Iran's most important nuclear and military facilities. Specialised bunker-busting weapons and broader air campaigns offer more credible options for such targets.The MOAB remains a formidable weapon, but its strengths are poorly matched to the realities of Iran's defensive architecture.

articles.title: A plan for 11 geothermal test wells split a California valley and left one farm with a reported $70,000 asking-price cut
articles.summary: A proposed geothermal energy project in Surprise Valley has ignited heated discussions among locals about environmental impacts and property values, highlighted by a reported $70,000 reduction in a farm's asking price.
articles.body: Geothermal energy produces electricity from heat beneath the Earth’s surface, and projects that tap it can raise difficult questions for nearby communities. At Surprise Valley, in California’s Modoc County, a planned geothermal exploration project has set interest in renewable energy against concerns about environmental protection and the future of rural land.The geothermal exploration project involves drilling exploratory wells to assess the area’s geothermal potential. Although the work could eventually lead to energy generation, residents have raised concerns about its effects on groundwater, the region’s hot springs, and neighboring landowners. SFGATE reported that Jeff and Sheila Cotton cut their farm’s asking price by $70,000 after prospective buyers raised concerns about the project, though the reduction has not been independently verified.The county's review outlines the scale of the proposed drillingThe project’s California Environmental Quality Act filing describes up to 11 geothermal test wells on nine well pads. The wells would be drilled to depths of 3,000 to 5,000 feet, allowing researchers to study temperature, pressure, flow rate, and the chemical composition of geothermal fluid. The filing places the 39.5-acre site between Surprise Valley Road and County Road 13. It also flags groundwater, tribal cultural resources, wildfire, transportation, and air quality as potential concerns. The filing says the project would also need three new access roads off Surprise Valley Road, while existing routes may have to be widened or surfaced to handle drilling equipment. It lists 15 jobs tied to the 39.5-acre site and identifies the area as industrial use under a use permit. This describes proposed activity, not a completed development. Exploration lets developers confirm that a resource could support electricity generation, and finding a suitable resource does not by itself mean a commercial power plant will be built.Earlier research established the valley's geothermal potentialEarlier geothermal exploration in Surprise Valley was funded by the California Energy Commission. The commission’s report Geothermal Exploratory Drilling, Surprise Valleydescribes a study that set out to evaluate underground temperatures and reservoir characteristics. Drilling of the Warner Mountain Energy-Exploratory 1 well (WME-E1) took place from May 15 to June 8, 2019, and reached 3,605 feet rather than 4,000 feet. The work included well tests, geological logging, geochemical sampling, and reservoir modeling. Based on that modeling, the report estimates that the well could sustain its maximum artesian flow for 20 years or more, and it characterizes the reservoir as shallow and highly productive at 230°F, with productivity indices that are high by geothermal industry standards. The above-mentioned study also notes the possibility of a hotter, deeper reservoir that merits further research. This is one reason the area has been considered suitable for geothermal development. However, results from a single earlier well do not guarantee the suitability of all proposed drilling sites.Residents weigh potential economic benefits against environmental concernsThe proposed exploration has prompted disagreement over how geothermal resources should be developed in the valley. Supporters see the possibility of jobs, investment and a new source of energy for the region. Others are concerned about the effects drilling could have on groundwater, natural hot springs, agricultural land and the area's rural character. The commission’s earlier report Geothermal Exploration, Economic Analysis and Distributed Energy Resource Demonstration, covers work on the eastern side of Surprise Valley, which began with a geoscience survey of about 800 acres and three temperature gradient wells used to build a geologic cross-section and a conceptual model of the resource. The demonstration stage included a 20 kW distributed-energy module tied to a 190°F hot spring, but a six-minute test with ten 100-watt lamps produced fluctuating, intermittent electricity, and the module was never commissioned.The above mentionedGeothermal Exploratory Drilling, Surprise Valleystudy also covered potential uses of the resource, including power generation and agricultural use of geothermal water. Taken together, the two reports show that economic uses of the area’s geothermal resource have been studied, although the demonstration module never reached commissioning. Groundwater, cultural resources and the other concerns listed above are among the topics the environmental review of the current project addresses. SFGATE’s reporting also describes residents’ concerns about groundwater, nearby property values, and the valley’s rural character, set against the project’s potential for renewable energy and local jobs.The reported $70,000 price cut illustrates the uncertaintyThe farm at the center of the reported real estate dispute raises another question: how does the prospect of nearby drilling affect buyers’ decisions? The official documents cited in this article cannot confirm the transaction, the concerns buyers raised, or the size of the discount. A single sale would not be enough to establish a broader decline in land values in Surprise Valley.The outcome will depend on exploration and reviewFurther development would depend on the results of exploration and review. In Surprise Valley, the economic and environmental questions are closely linked. Geothermal energy could bring economic benefits to the area, but residents are also concerned about the consequences for their groundwater, hot springs, and agricultural operations.You use AI every day. articles.title: Nursery owner in China jailed for life after hundreds of children poisoned
articles.summary: She and five staff members were found to have used the inedible paint in meals to make them look more appealing.
articles.body:
A nursery owner and five members of her staff have been jailed after they were found to have poisoned more than 200 children with lead-tainted food.

Li Huifang, who operated the Heshi Peixin Kindergarten in Tianshui, in the Gansu province, was sentenced to life in prison for producing and selling toxic and harmful food, according to Chinese state media.

In July 2025, 247 pupils and staff at the nursery were found to have abnormally high blood lead levels after children began falling ill.

A report into the incident found that chefs at Heshi Peixin had used inedible paint to "enhance the look" of its meals to attract more students - despite the paint being being clearly marked as such.

In addition to the sentence, the Lanzhou Intermediate People's Court also ordered the confiscation of 500,000 yuan (£56,200; $74,700) of Li's personal assets, state broadcaster CCTV reported.

Nursery executive principal Zhi Jinglin was sentenced to 15 years in prison and fined 300,00 yuan.

Four other members of staff who worked in the nursery's kitchen received sentences of between six to eight years, according to state media.

The court found the four had been instructed by Li and Zhi to add toxic and harmful ingredients to food served to children and staff.

Food samples were later found to contain lead 2,000 times in excess of China's national safety limit.

The investigation into the poisoning began after 235 children from Heshi Peixin nursery had to be treated for lead poisoning after eating steamed red date cakes and sausage corn buns.

Investigators found that the red date cake and the corn sausage rolls had lead levels of 1052mg/kg and 1340mg/kg respectively, both of which far exceed the national food safety standard limit of 0.5mg/kg.

Lead poisoning is "particularly harmful to young children" and can "severely damage the brain and central nervous system", according to the World Health Organization.

Officials later found that dozens of provincial officials and hospital staff attempted to cover up the incident by tampering with blood tests and accepting bribes from a nursery investor.

China has since published a set of national guidelines for the provision of meals on campuses. Among the measures is the requirement for every new batch of food to be tested, and for flour, rice and cooking oil to be purchased from centralised procurement points only.

articles.title: Starlink speed cap cripples Ukraine’s drone interceptors against Russian threats, Kyiv turns to US for help
articles.summary: Ukraine is unable to use its interceptor systems effectively against Russian drone attacks because of speed restrictions imposed on Starlink, President
articles.body: Ukraine is unable to use its interceptor systems effectively against Russian drone attacks because of speed restrictions imposed on Starlink, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Saturday. He added that Kyiv was in contact with US officials to resolve the issue.Zelenskyy told news agency Reuters in a WhatsApp media chat that Ukrainian officials had been informed that the restrictions were linked to technical issues. He said Ukraine had tested Starlink on European Union territory and encountered no similar problems, with the system operating at higher speeds.The disruption comes as Ukraine increasingly relies on satellite communications to operate interceptor drones designed to counter Russian aerial attacks. An Associated Press report earlier said a speed cap imposed without warning early on Thursday restricted data connections when terminals moved faster than 160 kph, affecting drones equipped with Starshield, the military version of SpaceX’s satellite service.The restriction has forced Ukrainian drones to operate below their usual speeds, potentially making them more vulnerable to Russian weapons.Serhii Beskrestnov, a defence technology adviser to Zelenskiy, told the AP that Ukraine was negotiating with SpaceX, the Pentagon and the US government to have the restriction lifted or switch to an alternative service package.“But we now understand that this is not only a technical issue and not only a business issue, but also a political one,” Beskrestnov said.SpaceX founder Elon Musk said the US government owns and controls Starshield, with decisions on its use resting with the American military and, ultimately, US president Donald Trump.On Friday, Trump said that he had not ordered the restrictions and did not believe Musk was responsible.The Starlink issue has emerged amid renewed Russian attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure. In a statement on X, Zelenskyy said more than 15 critical power generation and transmission facilities had been targeted across several regions, on Saturday.“Between 7 pm yesterday and 7 am today alone, more than 320 jet-powered and gasoline-powered ‘shaheds,’ along with loitering munitions, cruise missiles, and ballistic missiles, were used against our energy sector, our cities, and our communities,” he said.Zelenskyy added that restoration work was under way, with energy companies deploying available resources to repair damaged infrastructure.He also criticised Washington’s decision to waive provisions of the Lindsey Graham sanctions law, arguing that easing pressure on Russia could encourage further attacks.Ukraine is now exploring alternative satellite communication systems, including Europe’s OneWeb and a network being developed by Amazon, Beskrestnov told AP.You use AI every day. articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke shared a cheeky post featuring Shah Rukh Khan in his elderly look from the film Veer-Zaara.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke shared a cheeky post featuring Shah Rukh Khan in his elderly look from the film Veer-Zaara."How it feels walking out of jail after 24 hours with no wifi and phone," Dipke wrote on X.Abhijeet Dipke was granted bail on certain conditions on Saturday, less than 24 hours after Delhi Police took him into preventive custody over his planned 'Tiranga Yatra' in Connaught Place (CP).Delhi Police told news agency ANI that Dipke would be released after signing a peace bond, a written undertaking to maintain peace and comply with the applicable conditions.Dipke was detained shortly after leaving the residence of NCP-SCP spokesperson Anish Gawande, where he had been staying, to attend the planned flag march in Connaught Place.As he left the residence, a police official told him, "We are placing you under preventive detention. Section 163 is in force in Connaught Place. You are being detained."Before the detention, more than 10 police personnel had reached the house and asked Dipke not to proceed with the demonstration at Connaught Place. They cited concerns over traffic congestion, public safety and possible disruption to commercial activity.During an exchange captured on video, Dipke challenged the restrictions, saying, “We (CJP) never said we are holding a protest. We said we would wave the national flag. Is that not allowed either? Is the Tricolour unlawful?” A policeman responded that the flag was the pride of the country.Several sheets of paper were seen lying on a table inside the house, and Dipke was later seen signing them.In a notice served on Dipke, police referred to his public statements and social media appeals asking people to assemble at Connaught Place, allegedly without prior permission. The notice was issued in connection with proceedings before the Delhi High Court in two petitions.Police described Connaught Place as a busy commercial hub with limited entry and exit points. They said a crowd gathering in one circle could obstruct movement in the others, making it difficult to disperse people or allow emergency access.The notice also highlighted the area's numerous shops, restaurants, hotels, banks and offices, warning that disruptions during the evening rush and the festive season could affect businesses. According to the notice, more than 15 lakh traders and employees depend on the peaceful and orderly functioning of Connaught Place for their livelihoods.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: Ex-Reform politician likens party's response to criticism to an abuser
articles.summary: Sarah Cooper-Lesadd, who defected to Plaid Cymru, says she is "not surprised" by new allegations.
articles.body:
An ex-Reform UK politician has likened her former party's response to criticism as being "like an abuser in a domestic abuse relationship".

Sarah Cooper-Lesadd, who defected to Plaid Cymru last month, also said she was "not surprised" by recent allegations of sexism and misogyny within the party , claiming she had personal experience of such behaviour.

Reform UK says Cooper-Lesadd should resign and called her claims "outright fabrications".

An ITV undercover investigation, due to be broadcast on Sunday evening, has filmed several of the party's supporters and candidates over a 12-month period, with several making racist and sexist comments.

Reform UK said all those featured in the programme were under investigation, with some having resigned, while others were suspended.

Cooper-Lesadd was elected as a Member of the Senedd for Pen-y-bont Bro Morgannwg in May as a Reform UK member before switching to Plaid Cymru in September.

In an interview with BBC-produced Newyddion S4C, she claimed there was a sexist and misogynistic culture within the party when she was a member and said she was "on the receiving end" of such comments.

Pointing to two separate incidents, she claimed a prominent party member told her she "looked like a screamer" during a political rally.

She alleged the same member also told her she "did not need to be elected as she could be replaced by a 60-year-old man."

She said there was a wider culture of sexism and misogyny which meant she "did not feel empowered to report" these instances and claims they "would not have been taken seriously" by the party.

When asked whether Reform supporters had some justification in labelling criticism levelled at them as being part of a "woke agenda", Cooper-Lesadd replied that such comments were "straight out of the Reform playbook", likening the blaming of the establishment to an abuser in a domestic abuse relationship.

"Reform's playbook is if they can't defend the indefensible, they turn it on the person actually finding and making the allegations," she said.

"I think ultimately Reform needs to play within the rules other parties play by."

Reform UK said Cooper-Lesadd's comments were "outright fabrications from an individual who lied her way into Welsh Parliament".

"If Ms Cooper-Lesadd had an ounce of integrity or respect for her office, she would resign immediately and return the seat to a Reform representative. Instead, she invents wild stories to smear her former colleagues.

"The fact the media is taking these fantasies seriously without a shred of evidence is frankly astonishing."
